creatives.headline: Old Way vs New Way
creatives.scene: LEFT half (old way): an exhausted Filipino small-business owner at midnight, buried under laptops, paperwork and stacks of expensive agency invoices, cold dim grey light, stressed and overwhelmed. RIGHT half (new way): the confident person from the reference, relaxed and smiling, holding a phone showing finished polished ads, warm Grifon-gold glow, calm and in control.
creatives.prompt:
Photorealistic split-screen COMPARISON advertisement, vertical 4:5 format. ONE image divided into TWO equal vertical halves separated by a thin Grifon-Gold #FFCC00 divider line down the exact middle.

GRIFON DESIGN SYSTEM (applies to the RIGHT / WINNING half only):
- Background: deep near-black charcoal #09090B (zinc-950). NEVER pure black #000000.
- A dramatic Grifon-Gold #FFCC00 radial glow. Gold is the SINGLE accent hue on this half.
- Premium, crisp, sharp, polished, expensive, Hollywood-grade.
- The confident person from the provided reference image appears on THIS winning half, faithful to the reference, looking great and in control.
- A small gold "GRIFON AI" label on this half.

LEFT / LOSING half:
- Deliberately inferior: dull, desaturated, cold flat grey, cluttered, stressful, cheap, low quality — clearly the worse option. Muted neutral grey tones only (no bright colors).
- A small muted grey tag labeling it the old/bad option.

WHAT EACH HALF SHOWS (the comparison):
LEFT half (old way): an exhausted Filipino small-business owner at midnight, buried under laptops, paperwork and stacks of expensive agency invoices, cold dim grey light, stressed and overwhelmed. RIGHT half (new way): the confident person from the reference, relaxed and smiling, holding a phone showing finished polished ads, warm Grifon-gold glow, calm and in control.

LABELS (must be perfectly spelled and legible):
- Centered top badge / eyebrow: "BEFORE AND AFTER"
- ONE bold headline banner across the BOTTOM third, spanning the full width, large, perfectly spelled, 3-7 words, high contrast — white text with 1-2 words in Grifon-Gold #FFCC00. Do NOT overlap faces.
  "Old Way vs New Way"

TYPOGRAPHY (DESIGN.md): Inter / Geist / SF Pro — clean geometric sans, weight 700 (bold), tight letter-spacing.

STYLE: the RIGHT half is high-end and gorgeous; the LEFT half is intentionally cheap, messy, and washed-out. The contrast between the two halves is the whole point.

FORBIDDEN: pure black #000000 backgrounds; pink / cyan / teal or any non-gold accent on the winning half; GARBLED or MISSPELLED text in the BADGE or HEADLINE banner (the losing half's internal content may look bad, but the badge + headline must be crisp and correctly spelled); more than one headline banner; watermarks; stray logos; lorem-ipsum.

creatives.headline: Stop The Hard Way
creatives.scene: LEFT half (hard way): a chaotic do-it-yourself marketing mess — cluttered desk, messy half-finished designs, tangled cables, a frustrated overwhelmed person, washed-out grey tones. RIGHT half (easy way): the confident person from the reference, composed, one clean premium Grifon ad glowing on a phone, gold glow, effortless.
